items.summary: Reviewer disposition: reject the proposed weirdassstuff.com production admission. The click baseline is measurable, but site-level orders and commission are unavailable, operations/fleet-doctor evidence is absent, and production release controls remain unevidenced. CTO must document release, security, monitoring, and rollback evidence by 2026-10-03T17:00:00Z; principal-engineer must reconcile the admission ledger and nominate at most one fully gated candidate by the same deadline, escalating unresolved blockers to the owner.
